children: Shares of Escorts Kubota Ltd. were trading around 2% higher on Tuesday, September 1, after the company reported a 19.1% year-on-year increase in tractor sales for August 2026.
The company's agri machinery business sold 10,072 tractors during the month, compared with 8,456 units in August 2025.
Domestic sales drove the growth, rising 20.5% YoY to 9,523 tractors from 7,902 units a year earlier. Export volumes, however, remained largely stable at 549 tractors versus 554 units in August 2025.
The company said the tractor industry maintained steady momentum in August, supported by improving monsoon conditions, healthy Kharif sowing progress and stable rural sentiment.
While growth moderated from earlier months, demand remained supported by expectations of better farm incomes and continued agricultural activity.

Going ahead, Kharif crop outcomes, reservoir levels and the deferred festive season are expected to support tractor demand. However, a high base and rising cost pressures could moderate industry growth.

title: August Auto Sales: Escorts Kubota shares gain after co sells 19% more units Vs July
